script: Anna, mee address lo 'pakkane unna chettu kinda' ani undi, asalu ee area motham cement roads eh kadanna? script: Suresh, agura! Naku 10,000 steps padali, inko 500 steps ekuvunte kani nenu tea thaganu. Arei, nee watch ki nee kalla ki emanna godavena? Tea shop ikkade undi kada ra!
